title: Vello/Parley Render Plan
description: A version + render-config plan for a Vello+Parley (Linebender stack) rendering loop, as audited by scripts/render_plan_audit.mjs for version skew, AA config mismatches, Scene-model violations, and pixel-space consistency.

deps.description: Pinned crate versions as they appear in Cargo.toml / Cargo.lock.

wgpu.description: e.g. "22" or "22.1.0" — wgpu ships plain integer majors.

usesVelloReexportedWgpu.description: True if the code depends on vello only and imports wgpu via vello::wgpu::…, rather than pulling a second direct wgpu dependency.

duplicateWgpuInTree.description: True if `cargo tree -d` shows two wgpu crate entries (an incompatible-majors situation).

aaSupport.description: RendererOptions.antialiasing_support as configured at Renderer construction time.

aaMethod.description: RenderParams.antialiasing_method as requested at render time. Must agree with aaSupport or Vello panics.

presentMode.description: wgpu::PresentMode used for the surface. AutoVsync is the shippable default; AutoNoVsync is benchmark-only.

requestsRedrawEveryFrame.description: True if window.request_redraw() is called each animating frame (from resumed, after input, and at frame end).

glyphCoordsReinterpreted.description: True if Parley's &[i16] variation coords are reinterpreted to &[NormalizedCoord]/F2Dot14 before being passed to Scene::draw_glyphs, and glyph runs originate from a Parley Layout (not a hand-rolled bitmap atlas).

scaleFactorThreadedThrough.description: True if window.scale_factor() is consistently applied to both Parley layout and geometry transforms (no logical/physical pixel mixing).

cachesSceneInPlace.description: True if the plan diffs or mutates a persisted Scene across frames instead of calling scene.reset() and rebuilding it each frame. Should be false.
